protocol.selection: Fixed-seed uniform without replacement within actual-link origin x offline ROI-context strata
protocol.denominator: All actual emitted links, including revoked computation candidates. ROI context does not assert foreground ownership.
protocol.truth: Exact rounded current LiDAR pixel, annotated instance-local rigid source projection, depth-visible at both sensor times. No proximity labels.
protocol.assumptions: Annotated object treated as rigid between sample LiDAR times; residual camera/LiDAR skew remains a limitation.
protocol.background: No independently certified background identity: Unscorable
protocol.paired: Same physical link is compared across ablation methods by exact source/current coordinate bytes; retention recorded separately

limits: No multi-sweep fusion or 2px-neighbour truth labels.
Exact projected pixel still assumes rigid instance and sensor-time alignment; not physical certification.
ROI-context strata are not foreground ownership labels.
Background without independent identity stays Unscorable.
